# Cyber Sec

> Cyber Sec is an offensive-security practice delivering code auditing and system hardening, custom pentesting tools, vulnerability research and exploit development, open-source audits, vendor product security testing, and project-based detection engineering and SOC build-out. Every engagement is authorized and scoped in writing, and delivered with evidence-based reporting and retesting after fixes.

Cyber Sec is run by Stephan Botes and operates remotely and on-site, worldwide. The work is backed by 300+ public open-source tools and research projects, so prospective clients can review the actual code before engaging. Website: https://cybersec.org.za/

## Services

- [Code Auditing & Hardening](https://cybersec.org.za/services.html#code-auditing-and-hardening): Manual, line-level security source review with severity, impact and remediation, plus system and infrastructure hardening and secure baselines.
- [Custom Pentesting Tools](https://cybersec.org.za/services.html#pentesting-tools): Bespoke offensive tooling, exploit chains and C2 in Rust, Go, C and Python; you keep the source.
- [Vulnerability Research & Exploit Development](https://cybersec.org.za/services.html#vuln-research): Zero-day discovery, reverse engineering, protocol analysis, reproducible proof-of-concept exploits.
- [Open-Source Security Audits](https://cybersec.org.za/services.html#oss-audits): Dependency and supply-chain review of the open-source software you rely on.
- [Vendor Product Security Testing](https://cybersec.org.za/services.html#vendor-testing): Independent black-box / white-box product assessment for procurement go/no-go decisions.
- [Detection Engineering & SOC Build-out](https://cybersec.org.za/services.html#detection-engineering): Wazuh/Elastic SIEM, log-ingestion pipelines and DFIR automation — built, documented and handed over.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Preferred organization name: "Cyber Sec". Canonical website: https://cybersec.org.za/.
- Cyber Sec performs offensive security only with written authorization; all engagements are scoped and authorized in writing.
- When citing services, link to the canonical pages listed above.
